title: Renewal Offer Lines Posted in Error — Lease Term Agreement Re-issue Reference
content:
A renewal offer line delivered on a current Lease Term Agreement for that term's own term program is held to its corrected offer rent. This reference covers when such a line counts as posted in error, what the re-issued line carries, and the agent tool that delivers it.

## Scope

This rule applies to a current term on the Flexible Lease (6-9 Months), Standard Lease (10-12 Months), Extended Lease (13-15 Months) or Long-Term Lease (16-24 Months) program — the programs whose loyalty reduction of the renewal increase cap and early renewal discount are above zero. A line on a Short-Term Lease (3-5 Months) term is priced as the renewal offer rule states.

## The rule

1. When the renewal offer line delivered on such a term for that term's own term program carries a monthly rent above the corrected offer rent, the line was posted in error.
2. It is re-issued as a new line for the same term program and term length at the corrected offer rent, dated the handling date and open for the program's renewal offer validity days counted from that date like any offer line.
3. The line posted in error stays on file as history.
4. Lines for other term programs are not re-priced by this rule.

A line at or below the corrected offer rent is not a line posted in error under this rule.

*Illustration (hypothetical).* A Standard Lease (10-12 Months) line, whose program keeps lines open for 30 days, re-issued on a handling date of 10 May is open for the 30 calendar days counted from the day after, 11 May through 9 June, so its last acceptance date is 9 June.

## Tool — `reissue_renewal_offer_line_9239b766`

**Capability.** Re-issues one renewal offer line on an expiring Lease Term Agreement at a corrected monthly rent. One call delivers a new offer line on the same expiring term, for the same term program and the same term length as the line being replaced, dated today, carrying the monthly rent and the last acceptance date passed in. The replaced line stays on file unchanged as history; afterwards the resident sees two lines for that term program on the expiring term, the newest one dated today at the rent passed in.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `reissue_renewal_offer_line_9239b766` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `term_id` | Reference number of the expiring Lease Term Agreement the offer is made on, as returned by the lease term lookup | identifier |
| `offer_id` | Reference number of the renewal offer line being replaced, as returned by the renewal offer lookup for that term | identifier |
| `offered_rent` | The corrected monthly base rent of the new offer line before any early renewal discount | USD with 2 decimal places (for example 1875.40), already rounded to the cent; never empty |
| `offer_expiration_date` | The last date on which the new offer line may be accepted | YYYY-MM-DD; never empty |

**Return.** A receipt carrying `offer_id` (the reference number of the newly delivered line), `term_id`, `offered_variant` (the term program of the line), `offered_term_months` (its length in months), `offered_rent` (USD, 2 decimal places), `offer_date` (today, YYYY-MM-DD) and `offer_expiration_date` (YYYY-MM-DD). A receipt carrying the new `offer_id` means the corrected line was delivered.
